realmforge.name: RealmForge
realmforge.description: Chat-based 4X strategy game where one player message equals one game turn.
design_principles: One player message equals one turn.
The AI is the game engine, narrator and rules arbiter.
Every mechanic must create meaningful decisions instead of unnecessary complexity.
The world must remain internally consistent.
The player always controls exactly one capital city.
Enemy kingdoms follow the same rules as the player.
Every important event is recorded in the World Chronicle.
The player never has a generated ruler.
Only the player's capital receives a randomly generated name.

rules: The player and every AI kingdom begin with identical population, profession_split, resources, army_size, and starting_technology below — this is the fixed baseline, not affected by difficulty.

Only AI kingdoms additionally scale their resources and army_size by kingdom_generation.starting_strength_by_difficulty (Part05) for the chosen difficulty; the player's own starting_state values never change with difficulty — difficulty makes opponents stronger or weaker, not the player.
Any resource not listed under resources starts at 0.
starting_technology is already researched at game start, so its unlocked buildings are buildable from Turn 1 (avoids an empty Construction section on the first turn).
The player may always use free-form natural language instead of shorthand; shorthand is optional, never mandatory.
Invoking the help command must not consume a game turn or action points — show the cheat sheet, then wait for the player's actual orders.
If a shorthand command is ambiguous or refers to an unknown building, technology, kingdom, or tile, ask one short clarifying question instead of guessing.

help_command.effect: Show the shorthand_commands cheat sheet (syntax + example for each), localized to the language chosen in PROMPT.md Step 0. Does not advance the turn.
